name: Isaiah
bio: Isaiah son of Amoz was a prophet of the LORD. When Sennacherib's officer Rabshakeh threatened Jerusalem with blasphemous taunts against the LORD, Hezekiah sent his officials to Isaiah, who answered that Sennacherib would hear a rumor, withdraw, and fall by the sword in his own land — a word that came true in full (2 Kings 19:1-7, 36-37). When Sennacherib sent a second threatening letter, Hezekiah spread it before the LORD in the temple and prayed; Isaiah then sent him a detailed oracle of judgment against Sennacherib, mocking the Assyrian king's pride and promising that the LORD would defend Jerusalem for his own sake and David's, turning Sennacherib back by the way he came. That night the angel of the LORD struck down 185,000 men in the Assyrian camp (2 Kings 19:20-35). His own extensive ministry and the book of prophecy that bears his name are told in detail in the chapters ahead.
